senses.gloss:
mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं)
Ripe, mature.
m. (-क्वः)
A sort of mango.
E.
सु well, thoroughly, and पक्व ripe.

n. (-चं)
The leaf of the Laurus cassia.
E.
सु good, and पच leaf.

m. (-थः)
1 A good road.
2 Good conduct.
E.
सु good, पथिन् a road, अच् aff.

m. (-न्थाः)
1 A good road.
2 A country, &c. having good roads.
E.
सु good, and पथिन् a road.

f. (-द्मा)
Orris root.

n. (-णं)
Examining or trying well or thoroughly.
E.
सु, and परीक्षण trying.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well examined or tried.
E.
सु, and परीक्षित tried.

m. (-र्णः)
1 GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
2 A tree, (Cassia fistula.)
3 A cock.
4 A being of a superhuman character, or GARUḌA, and other birds of an equally fanciful description; one of those classes first created by the BRAHMĀDIKAS, and included in the daily presentation of water to deceased ancestors, &c.
f. (-र्णा or र्णी)
1 The mother of GARUḌA.
2 A number of lotuses, or a pool abounding with them.
E.
सु handsome, and पर्ण a leaf or feather.

m. (-कः)
1 A kind of Cassia, (C. fistula.)
2 A small tree, (Echites scholaris.)
3 A bird of superhuman character: see the last.
E.
सु good, पर्ण a wing, and कन् added.

m. (-तुः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
सुपर्ण GARUḌA, and केतु symbol.

m. (-ख्यः)
A plant, (Mesua ferrea.)
E.
सुपर्ण Cassia, and आख्य appellation.

m. (-यः)
GARUḌA.
E.
सुपर्णी a name of VINATĀ, and तनय a son.

m. (-र्व्वा)
1 A god, a deity.
2 An arrow.
3 A bambu.
4 A lunar day, in which religious ceremonies are particularly performed, as the new moon, and the eighth and the fourteenth days of each fortnight.
5 Smoke.
E.
सु good or much, and पर्व्वन् a knot or joint.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Extensive, vast.
2 Comprehensive.
3 Well laid out, (as a palace with all sorts of buildings.)
E.
सु, and पर्य्याप्त complete.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Completely fled or run away.
n. (-तं)
A total rout or retreat.
E.
सु, and पलायित fled.

m. (-त्रः)
1 An able or clever man.
2 A vessel of earthen ware, &c.
E.
सु good, and पात्र a vessel.

mfn. (-पात् or पाद्)
Having a handsome foot.
E.
सु, and पाद् for पाद a foot.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Drinking well, easily, or deeply.
E.
सु well, षा to drink, युच् aff.

m. (-र्श्वः)
The seventh Jina or Jaina deified teacher of the present era.
E.
सु good, पार्श्व side.

m. (-कः)
1 The third Jina of the future era.
2 The veined leaf^1 fig, (Ficus venosa.)
E.
सु good, पार्श्व a side, कन् added.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-नं)
Rubbing and kneading the hands and feet.
E.
सु pleasantly or intensely, पीड to pain, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-त्त्रः)
An excellent son.
E.
सु, and पुत्त्र a son.

m. (-ष्पं)
1 The coral tree.
2 The Śirīṣa tree, (Mimosa Sirisha.)
n. (-ष्पं)
Cloves.
f. (-ष्पी)
1 The plantain.
2 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa and panmorium.)
3 A flower, (Clitoria ternatea, the white sort.)
E.
सु excellent, पुष्प a flower.

m. (-रः)
A sort of lime or citron.
E.
सु well, and पूर what is full, (of seeds.)

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.)

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Sleeping, asleep.
2 Senseless, numbed.
n. (-प्तं)
Sleep, deep or sound sleep.
E.
ष्वप to sleep, क्त aff., and the semivowel changed to its congener.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Mischievous, murderous.
E.
सुप्त asleep, and घातक killing.

m. (-नः)
Midnight.
E.
सुप्त asleep, and जन mankind.

n. (-नं)
Dreaming, a dream.
E.
सुप्त asleep, and ज्ञान knowledge.

mfn. (-त्वक्)
Benumbed, paralytic.
E.
सुप्त, and त्वच the skin.

n. (-नं)
A dream, dreaming.
E.
सुप्त sleeping, and विज्ञान knowledge.

f. (-प्तिः)
1 Sleep, sleeping.
2 Numbness, insensibility, paralysis.
3 Drowsiness, sleepiness.
4 Trust, confidence.
E.
ष्वप to sleep, aff. क्तिच्.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Manifest, apparent.
2 Public.
E.
सु very, प्रकाश apparent.

f. (-भा)
Spirituous liquor.

f. (-ष्ठा)
1 Consecration, erection, (as of a temple or idol.)
2 Fame.
3 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines, containing five syllables each.
E.
सु and प्रति intensitives, ष्ठा to stay or be, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Consecrated.
2 Celebrated.
E.
सु, and प्रतिष्ठा to consecrate, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Certain, ascertained.
E.
सु and प्रति before ष्णा to bathe, क्त aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Well-made, handsome.
m. (-कः)
1 The elephant of the north-east quarter.
2 KĀMADEVA.
3 ŚIVA.
E.
सु handsome, प्रतीक form.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Splendid, brilliant, glorious.
m. (-भः)
One of the nine Śuklabalas or BALARĀMAS of the Jainas.
E.
सु excellent or excessive, and प्रभा light, lustre.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Enlightened.
E.
सु, and प्रभात shining.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Joined, attached, closely connected or in contact.
2 Well managed, as an instrument or weapon.
E.
सु well, and प्रयुक्त joined.

m. (-गः)
1 Dexterity, expertness.
2 Contact, approximation.
E.
सु well, प्रयोग junction.

m. (-खः)
A good archer.
E.
सु well, प्रयोग possessing, managing, and विशिख an arrow.

mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं)
Easy of attainment.
E.
सु well, प्र before लभ to get, खल् aff.

m. (-पः)
Eloquence, elegant discourse, speaking or discoursing well.
E.
सु well, and प्रलाष speaking.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Well-pleased, favouring, favourable.
m. (-न्नः)
KUVERA.
E.
सु well, and प्रसन्न pleased.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Kind, complacent, auspicious.
m. (-दः)
ŚIVA.
E.
सु well, good, and प्रसाद favour.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dawning finely, (as the day.)
E.
सु, प्रातर dawn, अच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Agreeable, pleasant, liked, loved.
m. (-यः)
(In prosody,) A foot of two short syllables, a Pyrrhic.
E.
सु, and प्रिय beloved.

m. (-पः)
1 Sauce, condiment.
2 Soup, broth.
3 A cook.
4 A vessel.
5 An arrow.
E.
षु to bear, प Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.

m. (-रः)
A cook.
E.
सूप sauce, कार maker.

ind.
Excellently, well.

n. (-नं)
Asafoetida.
E.
सूप sauce, and धूपन perfuming; also सूपधूपक.

f. (-र्णी)
A sort of bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.)

n. (-ङ्गं)
Asafoetida.
E.
सूप sauce, and अङ्ग member.
